title: Does repeating the rule settle down?
hook: Does repeating the rule settle down? Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.

doesNotKnow: Distinguish a locally contracting fixed-point iteration from a diverging rearrangement of the same equation.

misconception: Any algebraic rearrangement can be repeatedly applied to solve an equation.
objective: Distinguish a locally contracting fixed-point iteration from a diverging rearrangement of the same equation.

claims.text: The witnessed cosine updates have shrinking step gaps in their bounded interval. The contrasting rule solves a different fixed-point equation and doubles deviations from one, showing why repeated substitution needs a convergence condition.
